author: Akgames
quote:
Thirteen years in development it’s more of the same old stuff we’ve seen throughout the GTA series. Sure, there are graphical improvements suited to the current era and some refined mechanics, but the core gameplay loop remains identical (weapons, corruption, drugs, robberies, scams, etc.). Now, you can also go shopping, cook, clean, paint, and so on extra content to keep you occupied, but nothing that adds any real substance. The physics feel familiar; it’s as if they threw *Red Dead Redemption 2* and *GTA V* into a blender, tossed in some graphical and mechanical mods, and called it a day. Despite all this and all the hype I’m deeply disappointed by the sheer number of bugs and issues present at launch. Was it rushed? I mean, thirteen years and a massive budget and they release a GTA game riddled with bugs? As I said, there’s nothing truly new here; it feels like little more than a graphical remake with a few minor additions. Honestly, I expected more from Rockstar Games.

I’ve played GTA V with texture mods and lighting enhancements, and it’s not that far off from GTA VI... so I have to ask: 13 years for what? Where did all that money go? And why are there so many bugs?

author: Akgames
quote:
Recreating Link’s classic adventure in *The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time* with various changes, tweaks, and gameplay improvements refines and polishes the details of the original, enhancing the visuals and audio without losing the game’s core essence. These are the kinds of remakes that are truly worth it: you know what you’re going to get, yet you can’t quite imagine how it will be delivered. Congratulations on this delightful treat!

It is a wonderful way to offer young people and anyone else who missed out or simply didn’t quite grasp it' the chance to discover a game that holds the potential to shape a person’s life and character. Thank you, Shigeru Miyamoto, for giving us something that breaks away from the standardized, repetitive, and mundane nature of these times.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
